name: Build Zero-Lag APK

# Builds an Android test APK with EAS. Gated by project law (CLAUDE.md rule 1):
# 1. It is triggered manually and REQUIRES a build number typed into the
#    "Build number" field. No number, no build.
# 2. It fails closed when EXPO_TOKEN is missing. Add EXPO_TOKEN as a GitHub
#    Actions secret before this can succeed. Budget zero until then.
# To dispatch: Actions tab -> Build Zero-Lag APK -> Run workflow ->
# set the build number (e.g. build-2) and branch -> Run.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      build_number:
        description: 'Build number (required, e.g. build-2). Leave blank to abort.'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      profile:
        description: 'EAS profile'
        required: false
        default: 'preview'
        type: choice
        options:
          - preview
          - development

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build APK (named dispatch only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Fail closed if no build number was named
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ github.event.inputs.build_number }}" ]; then
            echo "No build number supplied. A named number is required (rule 1). Aborting."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Dispatching ${{ github.event.inputs.build_number }}"

      - name: Fail closed if EXPO_TOKEN is not configured
        run: |
          if [ -z "$EXPO_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "EXPO_TOKEN secret is missing. Gates fail closed. Add the secret in repo settings."
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run the gate
        run: npm test

      - name: Install EAS CLI
        run: npm install -g eas-cli

      - name: Build on EAS (Android APK)
        run: eas build --platform android --profile "${{ github.event.inputs.profile }}" --non-interactive --no-wait
        env:
          EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
